set.cycle_notes: Temporary Council resolution adopted October 2023, in effect until a date uncertain per the 2024 APR (March 25, 2025 Council report). The 2025 APR (Attachment 2 to the March 10, 2026 Council agenda) repeats the Program 7 text on inclusionary and linkage fees but omits the fee deferral sentence, so the program may have lapsed. State law (Gov. Code 66007) separately defers most residential impact fees to final inspection or certificate of occupancy.
set.prevailing_wage_basis: Labor Code 1720(b)(4) treats fees that are reduced, waived or forgiven as public funds and 1720(b)(5) covers loans repaid on a contingent basis, but the statute does not address a pure deferral; no City or DIR rule on this deferral was found.

reason: The 2025 APR drops the deferral program and no rule settles prevailing wage for a fee deferral, so status and prevailing wage remain unconfirmed.
